title: Breaking the limits of Ruddlesden–Popper cathodes to achieve a game-changer for proton-conducting solid oxide fuel cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8130-8141
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00993F, Paper
Yanru Yin, Hongfang Huang, Samir Boulfrad, Hailu Dai, Yueyuan Gu, Shoufu Yu, Lei Bi
The high-entropy R–P cathode, La0.4Pr0.4Nd0.4Ba0.4Sr0.4NiO4+x (LPNBSN), merges record-breaking performance with exceptional durability for H-SOFCs—a critical leap toward sustainable energy technologies.
